extracted.intended_audience: philanthropy practitioners, civic-minded individuals, and general public interested in philanthropy and civic engagement
extracted.subtask_description: A single TED Talk (Katherine Fulton, TED2007) sketching a 'new future of philanthropy' that emphasizes collaboration, innovation, crowd-driven approaches, and citizen leadership; includes five practical examples. The page is a talk summary/transcript landing page intended for a broad audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration and innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: The new future of philanthropy -- one where collaboration and innovation allow regular people to do big things, even when money is scarce.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize cooperative action and novel approaches as central qualities of effective contemporary philanthropy; prioritize partnerships and creative tactics that amplify limited funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crowd-driven philanthropy
rubrics_metrics.description: Giving five practical examples of crowd-driven philanthropy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value approaches that mobilize many individuals (the crowd) rather than relying solely on large donors; use replicable, crowd-enabled mechanisms (e.g., collective action, micro-donations, volunteer networks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizen leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls for a new generation of citizen leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage ordinary people to take leadership roles in social change and philanthropy; measure success by how well initiatives empower civic participation and grassroots leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact despite scarce money
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow regular people to do big things, even when money is scarce.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize strategies that leverage non-monetary assets (time, networks, creativity) and that design high-impact, low-cost interventions; assess projects on ability to achieve results without large financial resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of practical, actionable examples
rubrics_metrics.description: The talk illustrates ideas by giving five practical examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Favor concrete, replicable examples and case studies as a way to demonstrate and evaluate novel philanthropic approaches; practical illustrations are presented as essential for inspiring and guiding citizen action.
